title: Cusp-count evaluation at a prime power
statement: For every prime natural number p and every natural exponent a, ModularCurve.cuspCount (p^a) equals the sum of φ(p^min(j,a−j)) over j = 0,…,a. Here cuspCount t is the sum of φ(gcd(d,t/d)) over positive divisors d of t, and subtraction in the exponent is natural-number subtraction. The statement includes a = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ModularCurve.cuspCount (p ^ a) = (Finset.range (a + 1)).sum (fun j => Nat.totient (p ^ min j (a - j)))
